prediction_ledger.KNOWN: Exact registered Known ID; no anonymous token or evaluator remapping
prediction_ledger.NEW: Create a previously nonexistent global anonymous token
prediction_ledger.EXISTING: Reference an actually prior-created anonymous token
prediction_ledger.WAIT: No hidden class/token assignment; may become first commitment later
prediction_ledger.commitment: First non-WAIT is irrevocable within a replay; identical confirmation does not add membership twice
prediction_ledger.ordering: Strict event sequence and nondecreasing registered video rank; observation count must be integer, nondecreasing per physical identity, <= prefix cap

posthoc_join.fixed_universe: Every registered Known/Novel GT track, including missing/unmatched; distractors excluded from headline denominators, retained for contamination
posthoc_join.geometry: One-to-one, category-free temporal-IoU >= 0.5 as inherited; actual qualified primary-stream adapter/receipt remains pending
posthoc_join.unmatched_predicted_identities: Explicit None; never dropped from token ledger

standard.old_acc: Exact KNOWN hits / all Known GT tracks; never Hungarian-remap Known IDs
standard.new_acc: Anonymous hits under one global anonymous-token/Novel-only Hungarian / all Novel GT tracks
standard.h_score: 2*Old*New/(Old+New); 0 when both are 0; null if either role has no denominator
standard.all_acc: (Known hits + Novel hits) / full non-distractor GT universe
standard.novel_cluster_count: All NEW token creations, including unmatched/distractor/Known-misassigned creation
standard.unresolved_coverage: (Missing predicted GT targets + matched WAIT/no-decision targets) / full non-distractor universe
standard.dense_matrix: Zero-Novel-support rows omitted only for memory use, not from total cluster count; one global matching remains

persistent.fixed_opportunities: Every Novel GT target whose category exists in an earlier registered video, independent of predicted coverage
four_denominators: Fixed cross-video Novel GT reuse opportunities
persistent.correct_commit_ct: Pure correct EXISTING with a genuinely prior other-video member of same GT category / fixed opportunities
persistent.false_merge_rate: (Wrong-category EXISTING + reuse of already positively mixed-category token) / fixed opportunities
persistent.false_split_new_rate: NEW on a GT reuse opportunity / fixed opportunities; missing source does not erase eligibility
persistent.wrong_known_assignment_rate: KNOWN on a Novel reuse opportunity / fixed opportunities
persistent.wait_unresolved_rate: (Missing predicted opportunities + matched WAIT/no-decision opportunities) / fixed opportunities
persistent.effective_commit_coverage: Non-WAIT commitments / fixed opportunities; includes incorrect commitments, not an accuracy
persistent.contamination: A past different GT category poisons a token permanently. Unknown unmatched members prevent certification of purity, but alone are not proven false merges
persistent.time: Score before adding the current member. Later contamination cannot retrospectively erase an earlier correct commit
persistent.matched_only_metrics: Diagnostic only; never headline or eligibility source
